issues.desc: background.md line 5 (## Key Insights) describes H2 as checking each tamper verdict's "status/fingerprintMatch/dispositionMatch" fields, but the actual field name in tamper-verdicts.jsonl is verifyStatus (confirmed: 27/27 records use verifyStatus, 0 use a bare status key). fingerprintMatch and dispositionMatch are exact field-name matches. This is a harmless terminology looseness (echoes the execution-plan doc's own informal status: pass gloss at line 358) rather than a structural error, but the implementer of analyze-batch.mjs should read the real field name (verifyStatus) directly from tamper-verdicts.jsonl rather than from this prose.
